title: Supreme Court: Retirement Plans Comm. of IBM v. Jander
summary: The judgment is vacated, and the case is remanded to give the Second Circuit the opportunity to decide whether to entertain the parties’ arguments on ERISA’s duty of prudence. (No. 18-1165, opinion by the Court (per curiam); 589 U.S. 49).

title: Supreme Court: Ritzen Group, Inc. v. Jackson Masonry, LLC
summary: A bankruptcy court’s order unreservedly denying relief from the automatic stay of creditor debt-collection efforts outside the bankruptcy forum, see 11 U. S. C. §362(a), is final and immediately appealable under 28 U. S. C. §158(a). (No. 18-938, opinion by Justice Ginsburg; 589 U.S. 35).
